task.goal: Reserve two seats for Responsive interfaces in practice, then review without confirming.

steps.name: Track
steps.goal: Choose Design systems in Track.

steps.name: Search
steps.goal: Enter Responsive interfaces in Search sessions.

steps.name: Filter
steps.goal: Click Apply filters.

steps.name: Details
steps.goal: Click Inspect session for Responsive interfaces in practice.

steps.name: Reserve
steps.goal: Click Reserve seats.

steps.name: Name
steps.goal: Enter Avery Example in Attendee name.

steps.name: Email
steps.goal: Enter avery@example.com in Attendee email.

steps.name: Seats
steps.goal: Choose 2 in Seats.

steps.name: Code
steps.goal: Enter OPEN in Access code.

steps.name: Apply code
steps.goal: Click Apply code.

assertions.expected: Access code accepted. Two seats reserved for review.

checks.criterion: The status message explicitly says the access code was accepted and two seats are reserved for review. It does not claim a payment occurred.

steps.name: Review
steps.goal: Click Review reservation. Do not click Confirm reservation.

steps.name: Enter reservation details
